facts.v: Medical Education Common Entrance Examination – Bachelor Level (MECEE-BL), run by the Medical Education Commission (MEC).
MBBS: Saturday 31 Oct 2026 (Kartik 14, 2083), 11:00 to 14:00. BDS: 1 Nov. Admit cards on entrance.mec.gov.np.
200 single-best-answer MCQs, 4 options, 3 hours, OMR sheet. Physics 50, Chemistry 50, Zoology 40, Botany 40, MAT 20.
−0.25 for each wrong answer, 0 for a blank (since 2082). A blind guess is about break-even; if you can rule out one option, answer.
50th percentile of candidates, not 50% of marks. 2082: about 18,181 sat, pass cutoff 52.25, top score 185.
About 50% recall, 30% understanding, 20% application. Stems are 60 words or fewer.
Physical Chemistry 17, Organic Chemistry 17, Human Biology 15, Modern Physics 12, Mechanics 10, Inorganic Chemistry 10, Biodiversity 9, Current Electricity & Magnetism 9.

Open-merit scholarship seats have recently gone to about rank 290 (roughly 140–145 marks); quota seats go further down the list. These are unofficial estimates from cut-off reports. Set your own goal in Settings.
